Deprecated functions and methods

Source: R/mRpostman-deprecated.R
mRpostman-deprecated.Rd

As of the 2026 refactoring (3.0.0), the expression-based ImapCon$query() is the canonical search interface, and criteria combine with R's own operators (&, |, !). The forms below keep working but signal a deprecation warning once per session:

  • the search_*() method family - each call has a direct query() spelling, e.g. search_before("02-Jan-2020") is query(date < "2020-01-02");

  • AND(...) and OR(...) - write crit1 & crit2 and crit1 | crit2 instead.
